newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin meets Chernomyrdin in Kremlin -- Tass.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin meets Chernomyrdin in Kremlin -- Tass.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, back in the Kremlin for the second time in a week as he recovers from pneumonia, met Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin for an hour on Tuesday, Itar-Tass news agency said.
Tass quoted Kremlin sources as saying that the two men discussed the social and economic situation in Russia and the results of Monday's election in the rebel region of Chechnya.
A Kremlin spokesman said the two men met for more than an hour, but declined to say what they had discussed.
After his talks with the prime minister, Yeltsin met Ivan Korotchenya, who coordinates Russian policy toward the former Soviet republics, the spokesman said.

Aides say Yeltsin, 65, visited the Kremlin last week for the first time since he fell ill with pneumonia in both lungs on January 6. He had spent 12 days in hospital, but has been recovering at a residence outside Moscow.
